messages:
maya (product): Quick sync — we need to finalize request/response field conventions for GA. Customers keep asking for `token_usage`, `metadata`, and a stable `trace_id`. Putting a straw proposal here for scope + launch criteria.

cheng (eng): +1. Goal: keep wire format compact so we don't bloat per-request bandwidth or token accounting. leaning snake_case for the canonical JSON.

sam (api): FYI SDKs commonly prefer camelCase. We can normalize in SDKs, but agree on a canonical wire format. We should support both input casings for a transition period.

rachel (devex): Docs + quickstart will hide casing for most users. Important: be explicit about how `metadata` affects token counting and telemetry.

alex (ml): For token usage I propose this compact shape (no per-token arrays):
```
"token_usage": {
  "prompt_tokens": 42,
  "completion_tokens": 128,
  "total_tokens": 170
}
```
This keeps it easy to calculate cost and avoids huge payloads.

maya (product): Proposed launch scope:
- Required for GA: `trace_id`, `token_usage`, `model_id`, `schema_version`.
- Opt-in fields (not required GA): `user_metadata`, `billing_tags`, `provenance`, `cost_estimate_cents`.
Keeping embedding metadata opt-in because customers care but it adds complexity/size.

cheng (eng): Small operational notes: trace_id should be compact (base62 ~12 chars) so it fits in logs and header limits. Thinking header name: `x-rd-inference-trace`. Server will canonicalize header -> response `trace_id`.

sam (api): Confirming header plan. Also: accept `trace_id` in body as well and prefer header if both present. SDKs will surface `traceId` from header.

rachel (devex): `metadata` should be a free-form map but we need a size cap (suggest 2KB) and validation. Call out that embedding metadata will be a separate opt-in param to avoid accidental vector bloat.

alex (ml): For embeddings: customers want metadata attached to vectors for search. Suggest response shape for embedding when requested:
```
"embedding_response": {
  "embedding": [...],
  "dimensions": 1536,
  "metadata_id": "cust-1234-md5"
}
```
but default is no metadata field unless `include_embedding_metadata=true` to control costs.

maya (product): Scope negotiation decision: default GA = minimal required fields (trace_id, token_usage, model_id, schema_version). Embedding metadata and verbose provenance are opt-in params.

cheng (eng): Versioning: add top-level `schema_version` (string) in every response. Makes migrations manageable. Also, prefer additive-only changes for minor releases. Breaking changes => major schema bump and 3-month deprecation window.

sam (api): Draft launch checklist: 1) canonical wire spec doc + examples, 2) SDK mapping layer (normalize casing), 3) trace header + server canonicalization, 4) telemetry + cost fields implemented, 5) migration guide.

rachel (devex): Back-compat policy: additive fields for patch/minor; if we need to rename a field, keep old field for two releases and mark deprecated in docs. Also include concrete examples for customers migrating from our older token fields.

maya (product): Action items: @cheng draft the wire spec PR with examples and the `schema_version` plan; @sam write SDK casing and header handling plan; @rachel author migration guide and size limits; @alex enumerate embedding opt-in UX + cost guidance. Deadline: EOD Friday. :calendar: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: feature-flag rollout scheduled: schema-change playbook flag ON at 1763005600 for internal test orgs.

cheng (eng): I'll send the first PR tomorrow morning. quick question: do we keep `token_usage` top-level or nested under `usage`? My vote = top-level for visibility in logs and dashboards.

alex (ml): top-level is better. Also would be useful to include optional `cost_estimate_cents` to help customers surface cost without re-computing tokens.

maya (product): Agreed top-level, opt-in `cost_estimate_cents` is fine. We'll call it out as best-effort and not SLA-bound.

sam (api): Final note: SDKs will accept both snake_case and camelCase in inputs and always expose camelCase to users. We'll include sample migration snippets.

rachel (devex): I'll add examples showing `curl` with `-H "x-rd-inference-trace: abc123xyz"` and mapping to the JSON `trace_id`.

maya (product): Thanks team — once PR merged I'll publish the playbook and mark tasks in the roadmap. :thumbsup:
